description: This file is an initialization module for the torch.distributed.optim package. It exposes classes related to distributed optimization, such as DistributedOptimizer, and imports various functional optimizer classes and utility functions needed for distributed optimization workflows.

classes.name: DistributedOptimizer
classes.description: A class that runs local optimization on distributed workers, taking remote parameters and applying optimizer algorithms

classes.name: PostLocalSGDOptimizer
classes.description: An optimizer class implementing post-local stochastic gradient descent for distributed training

classes.name: ZeroRedundancyOptimizer
classes.description: An optimizer designed to reduce redundancy in distributed parameter synchronization

methods.name: as_functional_optim
methods.description: Utility function to convert optimizers to a functional style
